svg.text: E26 → fuse → HLK-10M05 → 5 V rail. XIAO C6 drives D4 through a 74AHCT125 into 10 serpentine columns. 5 V ring at the bottom, GND ring at the top.
MAINS — everything in this box lives inside the PC-FR mast/cap. Insulate every joint.
inside the mast bore, above the PSU
DOUT → next DIN, alternating top / bottom (serpentine)
5 V ring at the bottom of the mast (22 AWG) — feeds every column's bottom 5 V pad
GND ring at the top (22 AWG) — every column's top GND pad; one 22 AWG lead back down the bore
Current enters each column at the bottom and leaves at the top: equal copper for every pixel, even brightness.
• 10 columns × 15 px = 150 × SK6812 RGBWW (144/m, 12 mm). Cut at the marks; ~104 mm each.
• Odd columns (1,3,5…) mount DIN-down, even columns DIN-up, so DOUT→DIN jumpers are a few mm.
Firmware must reverse every second column (ESPHome: partition with reversed segments).
• Level shifter is REQUIRED: strip at 5 V wants ≥3.5 V on DIN; the C6 gives 3.3 V.
• Brightness cap in firmware ≈ 15–20 %: 150 px all-white at 100 % would be ~12 A. A flame
effect at that cap averages ~1.5 A on the 2 A supply.
• 22 AWG for both rings and the PSU output; 30 AWG is fine for data and the shifter.
• XIAO is powered through its 5V pin (VBUS); nothing on its 3V3 pin. Do not plug USB in
while on mains unless you are sure the meter/host is isolated.
• Mains: L → fuse → PSU; heat-shrink every joint; ≥4 mm creepage to anything low-voltage.
